what: DefMap::module on a published map (ModulesSlot::Published) reads the input field CrateResolution.modules, the whole module table, as DefMap::table does for a walk. A body step cannot tell the two apart, so blaze-item-hash refuses the read (classify.rs REFUSALS modules), and every inference that resolves through a published def map is not stored. A collected map has Modules::module (one module, covered as name resolution) and Modules::table (refused). Please give the published map a tracked query of one module, as Modules::module is.

history.note: Assigned to query-unify-port-hirdef: a tracked query of one module of a published DefMap in hir-def, beside Modules::module.
